scope: Invitation-bound passwordless participant entry, staging only
entry: Open invitation -> explicit processing consent -> request one-time email code -> enter code -> confidential response
identity: Supabase signInWithOtp with shouldCreateUser only when lookup confirms no existing identity. New identity uses existing versioned-consent provisioner; no password field or Company onboarding. Existing identity metadata/passwords/roles are unchanged.
newRPC: public.resolve_team_invitation_auth(text), SECURITY DEFINER with empty search_path, service_role-only execution and signed role check
recipient: Resolved from a valid unexpired, non-revoked invitation in an open team and active Account. Never accept a recipient email supplied by the browser.
proof: 10-minute encrypted HttpOnly email challenge tied to exact invitation digest; bounded code attempts; verifyOtp type=email then original authenticated invitation acceptance RPC and role/assurance gate
rateLimits: 60-second resend cooldown; 5 requests/hour per invitation and HMAC mailbox digest; global 100/hour; 10 verification attempts/10 minutes
privacy: No raw invitation/code/session/answer logging. Existing actor checks, RLS, response immutability, team threshold, report pipeline and worker unchanged.
templates: Signup: add OTP block, preserve current confirmation link. Magic link: add OTP block and use existing manual app confirmation endpoint instead of immediate provider verification. Preserve subjects, SMTP credentials, expiry and provider settings.
deployment: After explicit approval only: one additive staging migration and web deploy; update two email template bodies; bounded actual mailbox smoke for new audit_5 and existing audit_1. Worker, production, FoodTech and original fixtures remain untouched.
rollback: Restore previous web ed85d20 and exact saved template bodies. Optional service RPC disable revokes execute only; keep new identity/consent/fixture rows for review, do not delete history.
tests: 403 unit tests (8 pre-existing optional skips), lint/typecheck/production build PASS; isolated PostgreSQL23 groups PASS including all previous V22B cases and45 V22A assertions
